name: Snow Queen (CR 1) — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Snow Queen (CR 1) from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Snow Queen (CR 8)" but are not part of the Snow Queen (CR 1) entry, which is unchanged.

Defensive Abilities child of winter, hard to kill, recuperation

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee quarterstaff +5 (1d6)
Special Attacks hex (hypothermia, 2 rounds, DC 17), ice splinter 7/day (1d6+3), mythic power 9/day, surge +1d6
Oracle Spells Known (CL 7th, concentration +11)

3rd Level (5/day)—cure serious wounds, dispel magic, elemental aura S (cold) (DC 19), elemental speech, sleet storm
2nd Level (7/day)—calm spirit (DC 16), communal endure elements, cure moderate wounds, elemental touchb2 S (cold) (DC 18), frost fall M My (DC 18), holy ice weapon, shatter (DC 16), summon monster II

Base Atk +5; CMB +5; CMD 16
Traits House of Green Mothers’ Pupil, Rich Parents
Feats Alertness*, Elemental Focus M (cold), Elemental Spell (cold), Familiar Bond FF, Improved Familiar M, Rime Spell
Skills Diplomacy +14, Knowledge (nature) +11, Knowledge (nobility) +11, Knowledge (religion) +11, Perform (sing) +11, Survival +9
Languages Aquan, Common
SQ bonded spirit (ancestors, frost, lore, tribe), divine surge (inspired spell), oracle’s curse (reclusive), path abilities (divine metamastery, mythic domain, mythic spellcasting), revelations (child of winter, ice shape 7/day [21 cu. ft.])
Gear crystal tiara (7,050 gp), +1 glamered studded leather armor (5,025 gp), gloves of personal purity (1,000 gp), ice skates (1 gp), oracle’s kit (9 gp), potion of cure moderate wounds (300 gp), quarterstaff, lesser ring of revelation-child of winter (10,000 gp), 115 gp

ICE ELEMENTAL FAMILIAR, SMALL

Equivalent Wizard Level 7
N Small outsider (air, cold, elemental, extraplanar, water)
